purpose: Bind all durable learnings from the Make credit-storm recovery thread into one machine-readable preflight surface.

failurePatterns.symptom: An on-demand scenario continued executing when directly invoked by other scenarios even after its status was inactive.
failurePatterns.rootCause: Scenario activation state was treated as the only circuit breaker for a callable subscenario.
failurePatterns.requiredAction: Enforce an entry guard inside the callee and caller-side dispatch guards; inactive status alone is never sufficient containment for on-demand control-plane services.
failurePatterns.regression: A direct non-canonical call must terminate before the first expensive external read/write module; only the canonical owner with explicit refresh mode may enter the rebuild path.

failurePatterns.symptom: A state-changing connector action targeted the wrong resource and briefly reopened an unrelated GitHub issue.
failurePatterns.rootCause: Mutation tool/resource/identifier/intent were not matched as a precondition before dispatch.
failurePatterns.requiredAction: Before every mutation, verify tool action, resource type, exact identifier and requested intent; after an accidental mutation, restore exact prior state and read back once.
failurePatterns.regression: No state-changing call may execute when resource type or intent is unresolved or mismatched.

failurePatterns.symptom: A naive filter placed on the optional BG168 learning-share module would also suppress the downstream primary ReturnData module when the outcome is NO_ACTION/HEALTHY.
failurePatterns.rootCause: Primary result delivery and optional learning writeback are structurally coupled in a single linear path.
failurePatterns.failedApproach: Put a non-materiality filter directly on Share agent outcome with team learning while leaving the primary ReturnData downstream of that module.
failurePatterns.requiredAction: Materiality-before-dispatch must branch before BG168 while preserving an independent direct ReturnData path for non-material outcomes; learning failure or suppression must never remove the primary agent result.
failurePatterns.regression: For NO_ACTION/HEALTHY/verification-only outcomes, BG168 must receive zero calls and the caller must still return the exact primary agent result. For material outcomes, BG168 may run and primary result must still be returned even if learning is unavailable.

failurePatterns.symptom: The completeness addendum referenced connector-mutation-routing-guard-2026-08-30.json while the real canonical artifact was connector-mutation-tool-routing-misfire-2026-08-30.json.
failurePatterns.rootCause: A canonical index path was written from intended naming rather than exact readback of the created artifact path.
failurePatterns.requiredAction: Every canonical artifact reference must be derived from or verified against the exact persisted path; CI must read every listed canonical artifact.
failurePatterns.regression: The completeness test must fail when any canonicalArtifacts path does not exist or is empty.

failurePatterns.symptom: A first Make patch successfully inserted a BasicIfElse into Agent 14, while the follow-up patch that would move the learning/return branches returned 429. The scenario was temporarily left with an incomplete intermediate structure until explicit rollback.
failurePatterns.rootCause: A logically atomic routing migration was split across multiple live blueprint mutations whose intermediate state was not independently production-safe.
failurePatterns.failedApproach: Begin a multi-step live branch migration where patch 1 changes flow topology and patch 2 is required to restore complete semantics, especially while Make is rate-limiting.
failurePatterns.requiredAction: For structural Make migrations, use one atomic scenario_patch whenever possible. If the tool cannot express the full migration atomically, build and validate on an inactive staging clone or ensure every intermediate state is functionally equivalent and safe. After 429/502, read back before retry; if partial topology exists, rollback to the exact pre-migration blueprint before further design work.
failurePatterns.regression: No production scenario may be left in an intermediate topology that depends on a later mutation for correct primary return, learning, side effects or error handling.

BG167.latestPostGuardFullRunEvidence: The observed post-guard full BG167 run was a canonical BG166 refresh request, not a free-form direct agent rebuild.

BG168.rule: Materiality must be decided before paid subscenario dispatch; a classifier inside BG168 cannot eliminate the dispatch cost already incurred.
BG168.protectedInvariant: Primary agent result delivery is independent of optional learning dispatch and remains available on NO_ACTION or learning failure.

PH_AGENT_14_CANARY.evidence: After a 429 on the multi-branch patch, readback showed only the earlier BasicIfElse had been saved. Module 12 was then removed and readback confirmed the original flow 4 -> 10 -> 3 with error handler 11 restored.

requirements: runtime state distinguished from audit history
canonical artifact paths verified by exact readback
optional observability and learning paths cannot own primary business result delivery
multi-step structural migrations are atomic or every intermediate state is independently safe
completionGate.terminalRule: A chat/run is not fully green while material learnings exist only in conversation text or while a discovered prevention gap is silently dropped.
